newsitem.title: USA: CB Commercial Real Estate names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: CB Commercial Real Estate names new CFO.

text.p: CB Commercial Real Estate Services Group Inc said it named John Haeckel as its chief financial officer effective April 1.
Haeckel was previously executive vice president and CFO of Broadway Stores Inc, the company said. He would replace David Davidson who was planning to retire, it said.

CB Commercial said on March 18 it signed a letter of intent to merge with privately-held Koll Real Estate Services Inc. Under the terms, CB Commercial would exchange about six million shares of its common stock for all the shares of California-based Koll Real Estate.
